verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only peripheral first-party components described as open: BigCommerce's 'open source design system' for control-panel apps, plus a checkout-sdk-js SDK repo. Nothing shows the core commerce platform's source is readable under an open license; it is presented as a hosted SaaS with APIs and theme or headless options. Missing for 10: evidence that the core platform source is published, a named open-source license (e.g., MIT/Apache) for any component, explicit open-source status for Catalyst or Stencil, and independent corroboration.
